## IOffer interface

Plain make-side offer input accepted by [Offer](./midnight-sdk.offer.md)<!-- -->.

Use this shape when app or API data is already protocol-shaped and needs to flow into `Offer.from`<!-- -->, `Group.create`<!-- -->, `Tree.create`<!-- -->, or take-side conversion helpers. Use [Offer.create()](./midnight-sdk.offer.create.md) instead for new maker offers so deterministic fields are validated before grouping or signing. The `group` field is optional. When omitted, [Offer.group](./midnight-sdk.offer.group.md) lazily derives the content-addressed singleton group id from this offer's zero-group hash. `Group.create` copies offers into a shared group and overrides this field on the copies it owns.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export interface IOffer
```

## Example


```ts
import type { IOffer } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const offer: IOffer = {
  market: {
    chainId: 8453,
    midnight: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000001000",
    loanToken: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000001",
    collateralParams: [
      {
        token: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000007000",
        lltv: 770000000000000000n,
        liquidationCursor: 250000000000000000n,
        oracle: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000008000",
      },
    ],
    maturity: 1n,
    rcfThreshold: 0n,
    enterGate: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
    liquidatorGate: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
  },
  buy: true,
  maker: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000002",
  start: 0n,
  expiry: 2n,
  tick: 100n,
  callback: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
  callbackData: "0x",
  receiverIfMakerIsSeller: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000",
  ratifier: "0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000003",
  reduceOnly: false,
  maxUnits: 0n,
  maxAssets: 100n,
  continuousFeeCap: 317097919n,
};
```
